verses.english: Linked Discourses 12.34
4. Kaḷāra the Aristocrat
Grounds for Knowledge (2nd)
At Sāvatthī.
“Mendicants, I will teach seventy-seven grounds for knowledge.

verses.pali: Taṁ suṇātha, sādhukaṁ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmī”ti.
verses.english: Listen and apply your mind well, I will speak.”

verses.pali: “Evaṁ, bhante”ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṁ.
verses.english: “Yes, sir,” they replied.
The Buddha said this:
“And what are the seventy-seven grounds for knowledge?
The knowledge that rebirth is a requirement for old age and death,
and the knowledge that when rebirth doesn’t exist, there is no old age and death.

verses.pali: atītampi addhānaṁ jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇanti ñāṇaṁ, asati jātiyā natthi jarāmaraṇanti ñāṇaṁ;
verses.english: Also regarding the past: the knowledge that rebirth is a requirement for old age and death, and the knowledge that when rebirth doesn’t exist, there is no old age and death.

verses.pali: anāgatampi addhānaṁ jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇanti ñāṇaṁ, asati jātiyā natthi jarāmaraṇanti ñāṇaṁ;
verses.english: Also regarding the future: the knowledge that rebirth is a requirement for old age and death, and the knowledge that when rebirth doesn’t exist, there is no old age and death.

verses.pali: yampissa taṁ dhammaṭṭhitiñāṇaṁ tampi khayadhammaṁ vayadhammaṁ virāgadhammaṁ nirodhadhammanti ñāṇaṁ.
verses.english: And also their knowledge that even this knowledge of the stability of natural principles is liable to end, vanish, fade away, and cease.
The knowledge that continued existence is a requirement for rebirth …

verses.pali: avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārāti ñāṇaṁ, asati avijjāya natthi saṅkhārāti ñāṇaṁ;
verses.english: The knowledge that ignorance is a requirement for choices, and the knowledge that when ignorance doesn’t exist, there are no choices.

verses.pali: atītampi addhānaṁ avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārāti ñāṇaṁ, asati avijjāya natthi saṅkhārāti ñāṇaṁ;
verses.english: Also regarding the past: the knowledge that ignorance is a requirement for choices, and the knowledge that when ignorance doesn’t exist, there are no choices.

verses.pali: anāgatampi addhānaṁ avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārāti ñāṇaṁ, asati avijjāya natthi saṅkhārāti ñāṇaṁ;
verses.english: Also regarding the future: the knowledge that ignorance is a requirement for choices, and the knowledge that when ignorance doesn’t exist, there are no choices.

verses.pali: yampissa taṁ dhammaṭṭhitiñāṇaṁ tampi khayadhammaṁ vayadhammaṁ virāgadhammaṁ nirodhadhammanti ñāṇaṁ.
verses.english: And also their knowledge that even this knowledge of the stability of natural principles is liable to end, vanish, fade away, and cease.
These are called the seventy-seven grounds for knowledge.”
